## FREE PRODUCTION TOOLS

We’re very excited to introduce Soundwide — our newly named group with iZotope that now also includes Plugin Alliance and Brainworx. To celebrate, we’re giving away ETHEREAL EARTH, iZotope’s Neutron Elements, and six plugins from Plugin Alliance and Brainworx, all completely free, plus 10% off selected products for a limited time.

**Offer ends in: 05 Days 12 Hours 42 Minutes 13 Seconds**

![[img-ce-soundwide-announcement-lto-landing-page-01-hero-logo-new-c2683563e4145aaf068a6bf6cdbaed71-d.jpg]]

iZotope’s Neutron Elements is a more innovative way to mix your tracks with ease and confidence for home studios and hobbyists. Neutron Elements offers futuristic, assistive technology like Track Assistant and EQ Learn to give you a head start on your mix – and even help you become a better mixer. Neutron Elements also features four powerful audio processors to improve the overall sound of your tracks in seconds: Compressor, EQ, Exciter, and Transient Shaper.

[CLAIM OFFER](https://www.izotope.com/en/products/downloads/neutron_elements.html)

![[img-ce-seamless-crop-left-soundwide-announcement-lto-landing-page-02-neutron-elements-118165f593acfc4bf853a4c08ebbaa81-d.jpg]]

We’re giving away sweet analog saturation and compression with **Black Box Analog Design HG-2** and **Shadow Hills Mastering Compressor**, plus **Ampeg SVT emulation** – the amp sound that changed low-end tone forever. Also included is **bx_masterdesk** — a complete analog mastering desk inside your DAW, as well as the iconic analog synthesized sound of **bx_oberhausen**, and the rare console sound of **bx_console Focusrite SC**.

[CLAIM OFFER](https://www.plugin-alliance.com/en/products/pa-soundwide-bundle.html?voucher_code=JOINSOUNDWIDE)

![[img-ce-seamless-crop-right-soundwide-announcement-lto-landing-page-03-curated-bundle-6f910be155bab2f85fcd15b218bf0b0d-d.jpg]]

## ETHEREAL EARTH

Create new, atmospheric soundscapes and textures that transcend the ordinary. Native Instruments’ ETHEREAL EARTH combines worldwide acoustic instruments, from swarms of sitars to synthesized gongs, and adds creative processing for unique sonic environments. Get started fast with ample presets, then customize your sound with one-knob blend control and robust built-in effects.

[CLAIM OFFER](https://www.native-instruments.com/en/specials/2022/soundwide-offer/get-ethereal-earth/) [LEARN MORE](https://www.native-instruments.com/en/products/komplete/play-series/ethereal-earth/)

## ABOUT PLUGIN ALLIANCE & BRAINWORX

Plugin Alliance is more than just a website. Plugin Alliance is a new standard supporting all major plug-in formats and uniting some of the best-known international audio companies under one virtual roof.

Since 2006, Brainworx Audio has developed a reputation for creating sonically-advanced plug-in tools and a multi-platform development framework that is second to none, and has since joined forces with Plugin Alliance.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## ABOUT IZOTOPE

iZotope’s intelligent audio technology helps musicians, music producers, and audio post engineers focus on their craft rather than its tech. iZotope designs award-winning software, plug-ins, hardware, and mobile apps powered by the highest quality audio processing, machine learning, and intuitive interfaces. Native Instruments and iZotope became partners in March 2021.

This special offer is valid from April 12, 2022, until April 26, 2022, at the Native Instruments, iZotope, and Plugin Alliance online shops.

The voucher is valid for all Native Instruments software products in the NI Online Shop, excluding NKS products, hardware, updates, upgrades, crossgrades, educational versions, and products already on special offer. The voucher is valid for all iZotope products except memberships and academic SKUs. The voucher is valid for single Plugin Alliance products excluding bundles, subscription plans, Plugin Alliance online mastering services.

The e-voucher is personalized and only used by the appointed addressee/user. It is not transferable and may not be resold. If not redeemed, the voucher expires on 26 April 2022. Only one voucher can be used per product purchase. The e-voucher may not be redeemed for cash.
